title: Share Position
description: Share your current world position and dimension in chat.
body:
Share your current world position and dimension in chat.
There are three commands in this datapack:
- `/trigger sharepos` - sends your position and dimension to the chat for all players.
- `/trigger sharepos_private` - sends your position and dimension to the chat only for you.
- `/trigger sharepos_all` - sends position of all players in the server to the chat.

This is useful when, for example, you play multiplayer and you lost your friend, so you need to send your coordinates to the chat. Instead of going to F3 menu, finding the coordinates, and typing them manually, just use this datapack.

I also wanted the position to be copyable, but unfortunately I couldn't get it to work.
